muninn.notes: Muninn engine (Python binding, release build), local directory store; one write per original batch (coalesced for datasets with > 200,000 batches), compact()+gc() every 500 writes and at the end. Cold = database reopened (OS page cache not dropped). Engine thread count not configurable.

duckdb-native.notes: DuckDB 1.5.6, threads=6, memory_limit=4096MB, layout=native, latest=argmax, grid=asof. Cold = fresh connection (DuckDB buffer pool and Parquet metadata empty); the OS page cache is not dropped (no root).

duckdb-parquet.notes: DuckDB 1.5.6, threads=6, memory_limit=4096MB, layout=parquet, latest=argmax, grid=asof. Cold = fresh connection (DuckDB buffer pool and Parquet metadata empty); the OS page cache is not dropped (no root).

clickhouse.notes: ClickHouse server (official static binary), max_threads=6, max_memory_usage=4096MB, MergeTree, query cache off. Cold = SYSTEM DROP MARK/UNCOMPRESSED/MMAP/QUERY CACHE (OS page cache not dropped).
